mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.user_ingredient ( user_id, master_ingredient_id, category_id, name, storage_type, quantity, unit, expire_date, memo, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{masterIngredientId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{storageType}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{expireDate}, #{memo}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ui.ingredient_id, ui.user_id, ui.master_ingredient_id, ui.category_id, ui.name, ui.storage_type, ui.quantity, ui.unit, ui.expire_date, (ui.expire_date - (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d_day, ui.memo, ui.status, ui.created_at, ui.updated_at FROM public.user_ingredient ui WHERE ui.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ui.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT ui.ingredient_id, ui.user_id, ui.master_ingredient_id, ui.category_id, ui.name, ui.storage_type, ui.quantity, ui.unit, ui.expire_date, (ui.expire_date - (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d_day, ui.memo, ui.status, ui.created_at, ui.updated_at FROM public.user_ingredient ui WHERE ui.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ui.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE public.user_ingredient SET storage_type = #{storageType}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit = #{unit}, expire_date = #{expireDate}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE public.user_ingredient SET quantity = #{quantity}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE public.user_ingredient SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT ui.ingredient_id, ui.user_id, ui.master_ingredient_id, ui.category_id, ui.name, ui.storage_type, ui.quantity, ui.unit, ui.expire_date, (ui.expire_date - (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d_day, ui.memo, ui.status, ui.created_at, ui.updated_at FROM public.user_ingredient ui WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ui.master_ingredient_id = #{masterIngredientId} AND ui.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ui.expire_date ASC, ui.created_at ASC
